To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) process variations have the largest impact on the performance, while the temperature variations have the largest effect on the power consumption; 2) the performance of the cells is less sensitive to the temperature variation when the cells are sized with the minimum transistor size; 3) the power consumption is less sensitive to temperature variation when the cell is sized with the maximum transistor size; 4) for a cell with a fixed transistor size, the power consumption is more sensitive to voltage variation than the performance

(i) process variations have a significant impact on performance and power, especially for small cells, while voltage and temperature variations have a smaller effect, (ii) for a given cell, the performance variation is higher for the minimum size cell, while the power variation is higher for a larger cell, (iii) the impact of voltage and temperature variations is higher for larger cells.
• For a 14nm technology, process variations have a greater impact than voltage and temperature variations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following contributions.
the analysis of variability impact for different transistor sizing strategies in FinFET cells.

the following: (i) the impact of the most significant sources of variation on FinFET cells with three different sizing techniques; (ii) the impact of voltage and temperature variations; (iii) the analysis of the impact of each source of variability on the power consumption; and (iv) the analysis of each source of variation on the performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact of the different transistor sizing techniques on power consumption and performance is not significant in the presence of variations.
for the 14nm Fin FET technology considered, the transistor sizing techniques have a significant effect in the variability of the cells.
, for the considered technology and design, the transistor sizing techniques are not significantly impacted by the process variations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the impact of process variations is the most important source of variability for all sizing techniques, while the impact of the other two sources is negligible.
, the impact of process variation is the highest for all transistor sizing techniques.
, the transistor sizing techniques have a different impact on the cell performance and power consumption depending on the source of variation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
transistor sizing has a strong impact on variability.
the transistor sizing technique is not the main contributor to the performance and power consumption variations.
, for a given application and transistor sizing technique, it is possible to identify the main sources of performance and power variability.
